title: hakea centristigma
intro: Hakea centristigma, commonly known as the yellow hakea, is a flowering plant species in the family Proteaceae. It is native to Western Australia and is known for its bright yellow flowers and fragrant foliage. The health benefits of Hakea centristigma include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in wound healing and reducing inflammation.
